Closes the CC-GAP-9 residual in docs/plans/CONFORMANCE-CLOSURE-PLAN.md (CC-00C) and the CC-00C record: the TOCTOU window between the docker availability probe and the executor/compose substrate steps. On executor/compose failure the cached availability probe is invalidated and the daemon is mechanically re-probed with the existing bounded probe; classification rides only the observed re-probe result — never stderr text guessing. Only an observed unavailable/not-linux re-probe routes into the existing ADR-089 bounded in-check substrate retry and typed unknown warrant-blocked-environment outcome with human_required blocked/resumable continuation; an observed available+linux re-probe leaves a bad image/tag/config/product product failed. Compose down stays best-effort and distinct from invalid config; the three outcome classes (product-failed, oracle-insufficient, substrate-unavailable) never collapse.
